about.title: About Persia Azma System
about.subtitle: A leader in quality control and calibration for medical, laboratory, and industrial equipment across southern Iran
about.introBody: Drawing on the technical expertise of experienced specialists and current metrology technology, Persia Azma System is one of the leading specialized centers for quality control and calibration of medical, laboratory, rehabilitation, medical-imaging, and industrial precision equipment in southern Iran. With a deep understanding of the technical and regulatory requirements of different industries, we deliver an integrated suite of technical and engineering services, to the highest international standards, for hospitals, diagnostic laboratories, treatment centers, research institutes, and major national industries.
about.missionBody: To advance the culture of industrial metrology, reduce measurement error, prevent unplanned production downtime, ensure equipment compliance with regulatory requirements, and lower our clients' operating costs through fast, traceable, specialized services.
about.visionBody: To build a credible, dependable, and responsive platform for the industries and treatment centers of southern Iran — establishing traceable metrology infrastructure aligned with international standards to improve healthcare quality, strengthen patient safety, and support stable, consistent production processes.
about.qmsBody: Our quality management system is designed and maintained under ISO/IEC 17025 (testing and calibration laboratory competence) and ISO 9001. Every report we issue includes measurement uncertainty and is traceable to national and international references.
about.locationBody: Persia Azma System's headquarters is located at the Fars Science & Technology Park in Shiraz. Our geographic focus on southern Iran lets us offer fast, accessible service at optimized logistics cost, and our technical team is also ready to provide on-site services nationwide.
